name: Finger Spin
description:
You spin your orb on your finger, charging it with magical energy. Roll Dexterity against your orb's Difficulty. On a pass, the orb is charged with 1 MP. On a failure, the orb discharges all of its MP.

You may repeat the roll any number of times, increasing the Difficulty by 2 each time.

Describe how you spin your orb.
successes:
✨: The orb is charged with 1 additional MP.

🌞: The orb is charged with 3 additional MP.
